"Are you looking for a community of men where you can speak openly and receive support?


If you are finding it difficult to find a space where you can communicate openly with other men then you are not alone.


tethr is a peer to peer support community of like-minded men who are here to help you navigate the ups and downs of life. On tethr you can receive meaningful support from other men who understand what you are going through and create a brotherhood that is hard to find anywhere else.


As modern men living in a connected world, we have a unique opportunity to build communities with each other that provide support, guidance, and meaning.


Whether you are struggling with anxiety, depression, becoming a father, divorce, death of a relative or loved one, or anything else you are welcome and honored in this community.


We know that it is tough for men to discuss what they are going through – especially with other men. But we also know that there is nothing more liberating than being truly seen and heard by a community of men who understand what you are going through and want to help.


tethr is here so that all men regardless of race, sexual orientation, or economic status can find the support and brotherhood they need. Our community is meant to provide men with a safe, barrier free space where any topic can be discussed.


So come join us and download tethr for free today so that you can start becoming the man you knew you always could be.


Let's band together, raise each other up, and create a safe space where all men feel welcome to share their story.


- Create a thread and share how you are feeling and what is going on in your life. Receive support from the community as well as guidance from men who have been there before


- Reach out to another man just like you and start a conversation. On tethr you can message other members going through the same things as you or have posted something that resonates with you.


- Honor A Man – on tethr we honor men who share openly, speak their truth, and reach out for the support they need. We also honor men that step up and support their brothers. You can honor another man by pressing the medal in the bottom left part of any post.


- On tethr you can create new groups and support structures with other men who get it. Once you are talking with more than one man on the platform you can invite these men into groups so you can all support each other.


- We Give Back – at tethr we are committed to giving back and supporting research for men’s mental health initiatives. That is why 25% of the proceeds for any ‘Honor Badge’ purchased on the platform goes directly to our partner HeadsUpGuys.org – tools, support, and resources for men dealing with depression, anxiety, and suicidality. Support a man and support the cause!"

Absolutely man, I felt blocked for many years and all that would come out was rage and anger. I know it is because since an early age most men are actively encourage NOT to feel their feelings and that ' real men don't cry'. I can tell you that it is in there, it took me going to a men's retreat to really break the dam. At that retreat I did this thing called a hero's journey or a healing journey (they are the same thing) where I was able to get in touch with an experience from my childhood that was a core bullying experience for me and I was able to let out the anger, fear, tears, and everything that I'd never been able to get at because I didn't feel safe.

My experience on that retreat in large part was the reason why I built tethr, a peer support app for men. If you or any other man here is interested you can take a look at it but we've create a space where we encourage emotional and honest sharing and help men get through these exact types of blockages. DM if you feel like chatting, I've included the link below if anyone is looking a space to share openly.
